title: Law to raise income limit for senior and disability rent freeze programs
summary: This bill would raise the maximum household income allowed to qualify for the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption (SCRIE) and Disability Rent Increase Exemption (DRIE) programs to $75,000, beginning July 1, 2026. These programs freeze rent for eligible tenants aged 62 and older or with qualifying disabilities in rent-regulated housing. The change would apply retroactively to that date and would expire alongside related state income eligibility authorizations.
